# Homepage component distributions

Files are unmodified npm package distributions, retrieved with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` using an isolated cache. Licenses are included alongside each distribution. Only the compiled Basecoat stylesheet and the Web Awesome default token stylesheet, dropdown, dropdown-item, and their transitive imports are shipped.

- `basecoat-css@1.1.0`, MIT, `basecoat-css-1.1.0.tgz` SHA-256 `46eb1cedcd3845013d03a2f46341c63ec51f97185cef932eeb79a332a7c12b48`; https://basecoatui.com/installation/
- `@awesome.me/webawesome@3.14.0`, MIT, `awesome.me-webawesome-3.14.0.tgz` SHA-256 `ffc602ca68be6cb34520d728c2effceee7819559755d3d5aa7ca78f39b0fdf55`; https://webawesome.com/docs/components/dropdown
